description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015566204 CAP,FILLER OPENING: Line 0001 Qty 87 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0155 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
